title: Software Engineer
shortDescription: Join our engineering team and build modern digital solutions.
description: Evox Technology is hiring a Software Engineer to design, build, and improve web and mobile products for clients worldwide. You will work with the engineering team on delivery and on internal R&D.
applicationInstructions: Send your CV and a short note about a product you have shipped.

title: AI Research Engineer
shortDescription: Prototype applied AI systems and help turn research into products.
description: Work with the R&D group on applied machine learning, evaluation, and the path from experiment to a production feature.
responsibilities: Document findings for the engineering team
requirements: Experience with Python and machine learning libraries
Ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly
applicationInstructions: Tell us about one model or system you have taken beyond a notebook.

title: Product Designer
shortDescription: Shape product interfaces for Evox client platforms.
description: This contract role partners with engineering on interface design, prototypes, and design quality for active products.
responsibilities: Design end-to-end flows for web products
requirements: A portfolio of shipped product work
